summary: Backend tests for Iter 92.23.9 (Folder Briefing + Knowledge-RAG + Folder Sharing). All 14 new tests PASS, plus full regression on 92.23.7 (17 tests) and 92.23.8 (10 tests) — 41/41 green. Briefing endpoint (LLM call via emergentintegrations gpt-4o-mini) returns valid 4-sentence briefing for both populated and empty folders; foreign and non-existent folders correctly 404. Sharing endpoint is idempotent per folder, public GET works without auth, view counter increments on each fetch, items array is PII-scrubbed (only item_type/title/score/created_at for missions, item_type/title/created_at for chats — no transcript/wlad_assessment/strengths/improvements leak). Unshare cleanly removes the slug. Knowledge-RAG injection sets folder_context_used=true for both populated and empty owned folders without throwing.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/folders.py:329 — GET /api/folders/share/{slug} is mounted on the same APIRouter that uses prefix='/api/folders', so the public path is /api/folders/share/{slug}. This is safe because no /api/folders/* route requires auth at the router-level (each endpoint calls get_current_user manually). But it is fragile: if anyone later adds a router-wide Depends(get_current_user), the public share endpoint silently breaks. Consider moving share/{slug} to a separate router or adding an explicit comment + integration test.

routes/folders.py:387-390 — View counter increment is best-effort with a bare-except. If MongoDB momentarily fails, the request still returns 200 with view counter from BEFORE the increment but the response includes views+1 (line 405: `share.get('views', 0) + 1`). Minor inconsistency — for analytics-grade view counting consider returning the actual post-increment value via find_one_and_update with return_document=AFTER.

routes/folders.py:259-265 — Briefing endpoint always uses gpt-4o-mini hardcoded; there is no fallback model. If OpenAI gpt-4o-mini is temporarily unavailable the user gets 502. Acceptable for MVP but worth a graceful degradation (e.g. try gpt-4o, then return a deterministic fallback text built from items+context).

services_folder_knowledge.py:70-110 — `build_folder_timeline` ignores `item_type == 'note'` items (only video_mission + chat_session branch). Once notes are surfaced in the UI, the timeline silently drops them. Add an elif branch or a TODO comment.

routes/folders.py:337-345 — Public GET does not check whether the share/folder has been soft-deleted. Currently a hard DELETE removes folder_shares row → 404 (correct). But if a folder is deleted (line 147) the share row remains and returns 404 on the inner folder lookup. Cleaner: also delete folder_shares rows in delete_folder. Currently NOT done — orphan share rows can accumulate.

routes/folders.py:309 — folder_shares document is inserted without a unique index on (folder_id, user_id) or on slug. Race-condition between two concurrent /share calls could theoretically create two slug rows (the while-loop only checks slug uniqueness, not folder uniqueness). Add a partial unique index on slug + (folder_id, user_id) for production safety. Idempotency test passes because there is no concurrency in the test.
